title: Choose the visual world for qbitlab.tech
question: The roll assigned The Qubit Instrument. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Qubit Instrument
options.lineage: precision bench instruments and the qubit's Bloch sphere
options.thesis: The site is a precision instrument: turn the dial and the qubit points at the job AI takes off your plate.
options.viewport: A yellow instrument housing owns the screen: plain headline and Book a call engraved left, a display window where the 3D qubit's arrow swings to each service as you scroll.
options.risk: Turns gimmicky if the dial ever outranks the plain copy, and it is the heaviest 3D build in the hand.

raised.raise: Every service ranks hook, name, and outcome in three fixed tiers, in the owner's own words.
Each service is a numbered channel, CH 01 to 09, you can key directly and deep-link.
The 3D qubit is shaded from one ink family: no rainbow gradients, no glow.
Copy always sits on the nearest plane; the 3D moves in depth behind it, never over words.
One central axis, the qubit's pole-to-pole line, organizes the whole page.

options.label: The Job Ticket Rail
options.lineage: order tickets clipped to a kitchen or workshop rail
options.thesis: Every chore your business repeats is a ticket on the rail; QBitLab's systems pull them off for good.
options.viewport: A steel rail across the top holding live tickets like 'Answer 40 WhatsApp enquiries' that slide off as each gets automated.
options.risk: Familiar: reads close to kanban and project-management SaaS, and answers the 3D brief with a flat metaphor.

options.label: Design Annual Plate
options.lineage: design annual plate sections on uncoated stock
options.thesis: Services presented as registered plates in a design annual: precise, quiet, credible.
options.viewport: A near-white sheet, a large grotesque headline, a crosshair-registered qubit plate, and a filled black Book a call rect.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: services become plates and the stamp becomes a built-by seal; holds clarity, but SMB owners do not know design annuals.
options.risk: Can read as a design-studio portfolio, cool and distant to a busy shop owner.

options.label: Pulp Paperback Rack
options.thesis: Every service as a lurid paperback promising what it will do for you.
options.viewport: A spinning wire rack with each service turned face-out as a painted cover.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the doom-and-danger tone fights the trust an SMB buyer needs.
options.risk: Lurid tone reads as parody for a services firm.
options.kept: Three-tier cover lines: hook, name, promise.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The services as a broadcast index of numbered pages.
options.viewport: A P100 index page with each service as a numbered page.
options.case: Fuses poorly: page-number navigation baffles non-technical owners and reads dated.
options.kept: Every service gets a direct numbered address.

options.label: Live ASCII Render
options.thesis: The qubit drawn live in typewriter characters.
options.viewport: A rotating qubit rendered in ASCII density on black.
options.case: Fuses poorly: looks like a hacker demo, not a partner for a shop owner.
options.risk: Illegible at a glance and developer-coded.
options.kept: Tonal economy: all shading from one ink ramp.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: The camera sinks through painted planes toward a lit workshop.
options.viewport: Painted depth planes parting on scroll to reveal each service.
options.case: Fuses poorly: needs hand-painted plates this machine cannot generate, and camera travel delays the offer.
options.kept: Copy sits on the nearest plane; depth moves behind it.

options.label: Versailles Vistas
options.thesis: Services as garden rooms off one grand axis.
options.viewport: An axial garden vista with services as hedge rooms.
options.case: Fuses poorly: courtly landscape is remote from a busy SMB's day.
options.kept: One central axis organizes the whole page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The AI-agency site visitors expect, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero with a glowing 3D shape, an AI-automation headline, a service card grid, and Book a call.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every AI agency by design.
